name: Pending orders by time 2
summary: This EA places pending buy and sell orders at user-specified times during the trading day, allowing traders to capture moves at specific session times. It manages order lifetime with expiration and optionally deletes unfilled orders. The strategy relies on time-based entry rather than technical indicators.
summary_zh: 该EA在用户指定的时间点自动挂买单和卖单，用于捕捉特定交易时段的价格波动。通过设置挂单有效期管理订单生命周期，可选择删除未成交订单。策略依赖时间触发入场，而非技术指标信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于时间的定时挂单交易，在预设的时间点同时或分别挂出买入和卖出挂单，捕捉特定时段的市场波动。入场条件完全依赖时间触发，当服务器时间到达用户设定的小时和分钟时，自动在当前价格偏移一定距离处下挂单。出场条件依赖挂单的止盈和止损设置，以及挂单到期时间自动取消未成交订单。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，由用户通过参数设定每笔交易的交易量，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA允许用户设置止损和止盈点数来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大持仓限制或资金百分比仓位计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is time-based scheduled pending order trading, placing buy and/or sell pending orders at user-defined times to capture market moves during specific sessions. Entry conditions are purely time-driven; when server time reaches the user-specified hour and minute, pending orders are automatically placed at a configurable distance from the current price. Exit conditions rely on the stop loss and take profit settings attached to each pending order, as well as order expiration time which cancels unfilled orders automatically. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach, with the trade volume set by the user through a parameter, lacking any dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management allows users to set stop loss and take profit in points to control per-trade risk, but lacks overall account-level risk controls such as maximum position limits or percentage-based position sizing.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

parameters.name: OrderDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距当前价格的点数偏移
parameters.description_en: Pending order offset from current price in points

parameters.name: OrderExpiration
parameters.description_en: Pending order expiration time in minutes

parameters.name: DeleteUnfilled
parameters.description: 是否在指定时间后删除未成交挂单
parameters.description_en: Delete unfilled pending orders after specified time

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔法编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA unique ID to distinguish orders across instances

pros: 时间触发机制简单直观，适合捕捉特定时段如开盘或新闻发布后的行情波动
同时挂买卖单可以应对不确定方向的市场突破，无需预判方向
挂单到期自动取消功能有效避免了过期订单的意外成交风险
pros_en: Time-triggered mechanism is simple and intuitive, ideal for capturing moves at specific session times like market opens or news releases
Placing both buy and sell pending orders allows trading breakouts without needing to predict direction
Order expiration auto-cancellation effectively prevents stale orders from being unexpectedly filled
cons: 缺乏技术指标确认，纯时间驱动入场可能在低波动时段产生无效交易
没有动态仓位管理和账户级风险控制，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模
缺少新K线检测和重复下单保护，可能在同一时间点重复下单造成仓位叠加
未考虑点差和交易成本过滤，在点差较大的时段挂单可能不利
cons_en: Lacks technical indicator confirmation; purely time-driven entries may produce ineffective trades during low volatility periods
No dynamic position sizing or account-level risk control; fixed lots cannot adapt to different account sizes
Missing new bar detection and duplicate order protection, potentially causing repeated orders at the same time and position stacking
No spread or trading cost filter, placing orders during high-spread periods may be disadvantageous
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件（如ATR波动率、均线方向）以提升入场质量
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位计算和最大持仓限制
添加新K线检测和重复下单保护逻辑，防止同一时间点多次下单
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters (e.g., ATR volatility, MA direction) to improve entry quality
Implement percentage-based dynamic position sizing and maximum position limits based on account balance
Add new bar detection and duplicate order protection logic to prevent multiple orders at the same time point

risk_points: 缺乏重复下单保护，可能在同一时间点产生多个挂单导致仓位意外叠加
固定手数无账户风险比例控制，大仓位交易可能导致重大亏损
没有点差过滤，在高点差时段下单可能扩大交易成本
risk_points_en: Lack of duplicate order protection may cause multiple pending orders at the same time point, leading to unintended position stacking
Fixed lot size without account risk percentage control; large lot trading could cause significant losses
No spread filter; placing orders during high-spread periods could increase trading costs

It manages order lifetime with expiration and optionally deletes unfilled orders. The strategy relies on time-based entry rather than technical indicators.
